About your Incomplete (INC) status

Guidance for completing outstanding academic requirements.

What INC means

An INC indicates that the course has an outstanding requirement. It is not, by itself, a failed grade. The requirements shown in your individual record are the items to address.

Your outstanding requirements

Completion period

The PSAU Student Handbook requires grades of Incomplete to be removed within one academic year. An INC not completed within this period is automatically changed to 5.0 under the Handbook's grading provisions.

Completion process

  1. Review the outstanding requirements listed in your record.
  2. Contact your instructor through email to clarify the work and applicable instructions.
  3. Comply with the outstanding requirements during the designated completion period. Processing begins next semester.
  4. Follow the University's official completion process for the removal of the INC.

The portal provides information about your recorded status. Your official University record and applicable academic policies govern completion and final grading.

Reference: PSAU Student Handbook, provisions on Incomplete grades and completion period.
